import Mathlib

open Nat

/-
We start from the identity

    m² – (p+q)² = 5·p·q

which follows from the hypothesis
    p² + 7·p·q + q² = m²
by expanding (p+q)² and rearranging terms.
Since the left‑hand side is a difference of squares we can factor it:

    (m – (p+q))·(m + (p+q)) = 5·p·q .                (1)

Both factors on the left are positive odd numbers (they have the same
parity and their product is odd, because p,q are odd primes – we will
show that 2 cannot occur).  Hence each factor is an odd divisor of
5·p·q.  The only odd divisors of 5·p·q are

    1, 5, p, q, p·q, 5·p, 5·q, 5·p·q .

Using (1) and the fact that the two factors have the same parity we
obtain a short list of possibilities for the pair
(a,b) := (m-(p+q), m+(p+q)) :

    (1,5·p·q) , (5,p·q) , (p,5·q) , (q,5·p) .

The cases (p,5·q) and (q,5·p) force p = q, while the case (1,5·p·q)
leads to an impossible inequality.  The remaining case (5,p·q) gives

    (p-2)(q-2) = 9 ,

so (p,q) = (3,11), (5,5) or (11,3).  The solution (5,5) belongs to the
family p = q.  Putting everything together we obtain the desired
characterisation.
-/

    (∃ m : ℕ, p ^ 2 + 7 * p * q + q ^ 2 = m ^ 2) ↔
      (p = q ∨ (p = 3 ∧ q = 11) ∨ (p = 11 ∧ q = 3)) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨m, hm⟩
    -- First we rule out the prime 2.
    have hodd : p % 2 = 1 ∧ q % 2 = 1 := by
      have hp2 : p ≠ 2 := by
        intro h₂
        have : (p ^ 2 + 7 * p * q + q ^ 2) % 4 = (2 ^ 2 + 7 * 2 * q + q ^ 2) % 4 := by
          simpa [h₂]
        have : (m ^ 2) % 4 = (p ^ 2 + 7 * p * q + q ^ 2) % 4 := by
          simpa [hm] using rfl
        have : (m ^ 2) % 4 = 0 ∨ (m ^ 2) % 4 = 1 := Nat.mod_mul_left_mod _ _
        have : (2 ^ 2 + 7 * 2 * q + q ^ 2) % 4 = 2 := by
          have : (2 : ℕ) % 4 = 2 := rfl
          have : (7 * 2 * q) % 4 = (14 * q) % 4 := by rfl
          have : (14 * q) % 4 = (2 * q) % 4 := by
            simpa [Nat.mul_mod] using congrArg (fun x => x % 4) (by ring)
          have : (q ^ 2) % 4 = (q % 2) ^ 2 % 4 := by
            simpa [Nat.pow_two, Nat.mod_mul_left_mod] using rfl
          sorry
        sorry
      have hq2 : q ≠ 2 := by
        intro h₂
        have : (p ^ 2 + 7 * p * q + q ^ 2) % 4 = (p ^ 2 + 7 * p * 2 + 2 ^ 2) % 4 := by
          simpa [h₂]
        have : (m ^ 2) % 4 = (p ^ 2 + 7 * p * q + q ^ 2) % 4 := by
          simpa [hm] using rfl
        have : (m ^ 2) % 4 = 0 ∨ (m ^ 2) % 4 = 1 := Nat.mod_mul_left_mod _ _
        have : (p ^ 2 + 7 * p * 2 + 2 ^ 2) % 4 = 2 := by
          have : (2 : ℕ) % 4 = 2 := rfl
          have : (7 * p * 2) % 4 = (14 * p) % 4 := by rfl
          have : (14 * p) % 4 = (2 * p) % 4 := by
            simpa [Nat.mul_mod] using congrArg (fun x => x % 4) (by ring)
          have : (p ^ 2) % 4 = (p % 2) ^ 2 % 4 := by
            simpa [Nat.pow_two, Nat.mod_mul_left_mod] using rfl
          sorry
        sorry
      have : p % 2 = 1 := by
        have : p ≠ 2 := hp2
        have : p % 2 = 0 ∨ p % 2 = 1 := Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one p

        | inl h0 => exact (by
            have : p = 2 := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_mod_eq_zero h0) (by decide)
            exact (hp2 this).elim)
        | inr h1 => exact h1
      have : q % 2 = 1 := by
        have : q ≠ 2 := hq2
        have : q % 2 = 0 ∨ q % 2 = 1 := Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one q
        cases this with
        | inl h0 => exact (by
            have : q = 2 := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_mod_eq_zero h0) (by decide)
            exact (hq2 this).elim)
        | inr h1 => exact h1
      exact ⟨‹_›, ‹_›⟩
    have hodd' : Odd p ∧ Odd q := by
      rcases hodd with ⟨hpodd, hqodd⟩
      exact ⟨odd_iff_not_even.mpr (by
        intro h; have : p % 2 = 0 := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_mod_eq_zero h) (by decide)
        exact (hpodd this).elim),
        odd_iff_not_even.mpr (by
          intro h; have : q % 2 = 0 := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_mod_eq_zero h) (by decide)
          exact (hqodd this).elim)⟩
    -- Set a = m-(p+q) and b = m+(p+q)
    have hpos : p + q ≤ m := by
      have : (p + q) ^ 2 < p ^ 2 + 7 * p * q + q ^ 2 := by
        have : (p + q) ^ 2 = p ^ 2 + 2 * p * q + q ^ 2 := by ring
        have : p ^ 2 + 2 * p * q + q ^ 2 < p ^ 2 + 7 * p * q + q ^ 2 := by
          have : (2 : ℕ) < 7 := by decide
          exact Nat.add_lt_add_left (Nat.mul_lt_mul_left _ this) _
        simpa [this] using this
      have : (p + q) ^ 2 < m ^ 2 := by
        simpa [hm] using this
      exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Nat.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left this (Nat.succ_pos _))

        have : (p + q) ^ 2 + 5 * p * q = m ^ 2 := by
          simpa [this] using hm.symm
        linarith
      have hfactor : (m - (p + q)) * (m + (p + q)) = m ^ 2 - (p + q) ^ 2 := by
        have : (m - (p + q)) * (m + (p + q)) = m ^ 2 - (p + q) ^ 2 := by
          ring
        exact this
      simpa [ha, hb, Nat.sub_eq_iff_eq_add] using (by
        have : (m - (p + q)) * (m + (p + q)) = 5 * p * q := by
          simpa [hdiff] using hfactor
        exact this)
    have hoddab : Odd a ∧ Odd b := by
      have : Odd (5 * p * q) := by
        have : Odd (5 : ℕ) := by decide
        have : Odd p := (Nat.prime_odd hp).mpr (by decide)
        have : Odd q := (Nat.prime_odd hq).mpr (by decide)
        exact odd_mul (odd_mul (by decide) (Nat.prime_odd hp).mpr (by decide)) (Nat.prime_odd hq).mpr (by decide)
      have hodd_mul : Odd a ∧ Odd b := odd_mul.mp (by
        simpa [hab] using this)
      exact hodd_mul

      have : 5 ∣ a * b := by
        simpa [hab] using dvd_mul_right (5) (p * q)
      exact this)
    have hdivp : p ∣ a ∨ p ∣ b := (hp.dvd_mul).1 (by
      have : p ∣ a * b := by
        simpa [hab] using dvd_mul_right (p) (5 * q)
      exact this)
    have hdivq : q ∣ a ∨ q ∣ b := (hq.dvd_mul).1 (by
      have : q ∣ a * b := by
        simpa [hab] using dvd_mul_right (q) (5 * p)
      exact this)

        (a = p ∧ b = 5 * q) ∨

          have h5b : 5 ∣ b := h

            have : 5 ∣ a * b := by

          exact this

        | inl h => exact h
        | inr h =>

            have : p ∣ a * b := by
              simpa [hab] using dvd_mul_right (p) (5 * q)
            exact (Nat.prime.dvd_mul hp).1 this |>.resolve_right hpb
          exact this
